context_requirements: Functional wild-type TP53 protein (most sensitive lines are TP53 wild-type)
Intact p53 transcriptional machinery and downstream target promoters
Cellular stress or basal p53 activity that can be suppressed by the inhibitor
TP53-mutant or null lines are expected to show little or no specific response
falsifiers: No decrease in canonical p53 target genes (CDKN1A, MDM2, GADD45A, BAX) at 6 h in TP53 wild-type lines
Strong induction of p53 target genes rather than suppression
Equivalent transcriptional responses in TP53-mutant/null lines and TP53 wild-type lines
No cell-cycle or apoptosis-related changes at 24 h in responsive lines
Responses indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines

evidence.supports: TP53 inhibitor PFTα modulates TP53 and cell cycle signaling and enhances ATO-induced transcriptional changes in TP53 wild-type tumor cells
TP53-inhibitor Pifitrin-α reduces the anti-tumor activity of LNA-i-miR-221 selectively in TP53 wild-type colorectal cancer cells
